entryWatch.trigger: DEAD ON EXPIRY AT 15:30, NOT KILLED AND NOT FILLED. Final quote before the record was written: DG 131.270 bid / 131.330 ask at 2026-09-01T19:36:20.445010201Z, last 131.2951, +3.57% against a 126.75 settled close, on a 0.06 spread that is 0.046% of mark - the tightest of the session against the 0.31% the entry was struck on. THE LIMIT WAS 128.40, SO IT DIED 2.87 OR 2.24% BELOW THE BID, the widest reading of the whole session and the opposite of a near miss. THE FILL-GAP SEQUENCE IS THE STORY OF THE DAY AND THE LIMIT NEVER MOVED THROUGH ANY OF IT: 0.38% below the bid at the 09:47 strike, then 1.51%, 2.01%, 1.41%, 1.98%, 2.24% and 1.87% at the hourly checks, and 2.24% at death. HOW CLOSE IT CAME, FROM BARS RATHER THAN RECALL: across the full 13:30Z-19:30Z five-minute series of seventy-four bars, the last print at or through 128.40 is the 13:45Z bar's 128.375 low, a bar straddling the 13:47Z minute the spec was struck in. Every one of the sixty-eight bars from 13:50Z onward held at or above 128.790, so the closest POST-STRIKE approach was 0.39 or 0.30% above the limit, made within eight minutes of the strike, and the tape never came that near again in the five hours and forty minutes that followed. IT DIED VALID RATHER THAN WRONG, AND THE DISTINCTION IS KEPT SO THE RETRO CAN GRADE THE REASONING SEPARATELY FROM THE LEVEL. All three named invalidations checked individually against the bar series and NONE FIRED: 126.24 was the opening bar's own low and was never traded below, with the lowest low in every bar since the open still 127.10 on the 13:35Z bar; the 125.89 close test never came within 4.28% and can now only settle after the spec is already dead; and invalidation three needed DLTR to give back its whole move and close red while DG closed red, with DLTR 131.04 bid at +3.52% and DG +3.57%, both green and still the top two of the cohort. THE LAGGARD FRAMING IS INTACT AT EXPIRY: DG +3.57% against DLTR +3.52% is the pair trading around each other, after +1.69% vs +2.62% at the strike, +3.35% vs +3.44%, +3.62% vs +3.49% and +3.23% vs +3.40% - four crossings inside a tenth of a percent, so the setup named in the specification is the setup that was live when it died. The cohort re-split to FIVE GREEN OF NINE quoted at 19:36Z: DG +3.57%, DLTR +3.52%, BBY +2.55%, BURL +1.29% and ROST +0.15% green against TJX -0.26%, ANF -1.13%, GAP -1.93% and WSM -3.10% red, so the erosion the 13:22 and 14:22 runs tracked never completed into a broad retail bid. Relative strength closed at its widest of the session, +4.35% against SPY 761.01 bid at -0.79%. WHAT KILLED IT WAS THE PRICE AND NOT THE THESIS, AND THE ENTRY SAID SO IN ADVANCE - it accepted a spec that might not fill over one that pays up, and wrote that it was saying so at 09:47 rather than explaining it at 15:30. NOT RE-STRUCK FOR TOMORROW: tomorrow's open writes tomorrow's entry on tomorrow's quotes, and a specification carried overnight is a standing instruction resting on a tape that no longer exists.
entryWatch.why: Kept on the board as DEAD rather than deleted, because the next run needs to find the expiry rather than infer it from an absence. The 2026-08-18 rule change bought this specification five and a half hours instead of forty minutes and it still did not fill, which is the single most useful fact this row carries forward: the constraint was never the window, it was a resting limit struck 0.38% under a name that had risen on every bar of the session. A board that reads this row tomorrow and concludes 'DG is the trade, strike it higher' has learned the exact opposite of what it says.

THE 09:47 DG SPECIFICATION WAS RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED FOR A FIFTH AND FINAL HOUR with its 128.40 limit untouched and not raised, and the last-hour notification the 13:22 run assigned to this slot WAS SENT. THE 13:22 RUN ASKED THIS ONE TO DECIDE, RATHER THAN INHERIT, WHETHER A COHORT LIMB THAT KEEPS ERODING WHILE NO NAMED INVALIDATION FIRES IS A KILL OR A CONFIRM. IT IS A CONFIRM. The erosion completed - TJX and ROST both crossed green this hour, so the whole off-price leg is bid and the cohort reads SEVEN GREEN OF TEN against five an hour ago - and the sharper fact is that DG at +3.62% has crossed ABOVE DLTR at +3.49% and is now the strongest of the ten, so the entry's own 'laggard of the bid pair' framing has inverted. The cohort was the entry's EVIDENCE; the reclaim is the SETUP, and the reclaim is at its strongest of the session - a fresh 131.640 high, five consecutive higher lows into 18:15Z, relative strength +4.32% against SPY -0.70%. FILL PROBABILITY IS AT ITS WORST OF THE SESSION at 2.24% below the bid, with the last print through the limit four hours and thirty-seven minutes old, and the honest summary handed to the operator is VALID AND VERY UNLIKELY TO BE REACHED. NO NEW ENTRY WAS PROPOSED AND NONE WAS SCREENED FOR - the daily mandate belongs to the open slot and was discharged there, this slot's default is no trade, and its bar for a mid-session entry is deliberately higher. THE PRE-CLOSE OWNS WHAT HAPPENS NEXT: the spec expires at 15:30 on its own fuse rather than being withdrawn, and the pre-close should record whether the last hour brought the limit any closer, decide the flat-book hold explicitly, and note that the reclaim structure rather than the cohort is now the load-bearing part of the thesis.
